subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear permanently replace the separate Agent and Session pages with Home-based previous/next controls and support model selection through the new capability-gated Phone companion protocol?
rationale: The implementation and proof support a viable path, but choosing the durable constrained-watch navigation and paired-device contract is a product and ownership decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Sponsor the Home-centered Wear flow
options.body: Confirm the three-page navigation and negotiated model-control protocol as the intended Wear UX, then merge after required Android checks complete.

options.title: Retain dedicated context pages
options.body: Keep the current separate Agent and Session destinations and ask for a narrower alternative that improves switching without changing the pager model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Home-centered Wear flow
recommendation.body: Confirm the three-page navigation and negotiated model-control protocol as the intended Wear UX, then merge after required Android checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and its final Android/Wear hardening commits were authored by steipete.
